about: Location tree (sxs/policy/zones.py): zones, CP, exploration, blessing, connections.

Auroradrasil.notes: Free 4-player story dungeon (R-133); Lost Goddess Statue blessed 2026-11-05.

Damp Woods.notes: 15.5 is the Gate of Power inside (R-086), not an area-map gate. An area-map walk to its label from Verdantglade II lands at about (184, 86); items behind the gate finish it.

Highland Woods.notes: Entered past a bracketed wolf-boss pack (R-041); ground pickups by a cooking pot finish it (R-066).

failed_via.Drasilgard: 2026-11-05 (walked in from the south edge; big-map walks mostly no_move, no % gained)

Jungle Camp.notes: Next by R-135 order. Entry point unknown.

Moonveil Woods.notes: Dungeon gate unlocked by quest; Bellflower field at minimap (169, 94-95) (R-123).

Stone Ruins I.notes: 2x2 stone-tile puzzle spawns two chests (R-089 area).

Sunrise Isle.notes: Bottom right of the Verdantglade map; its % isn't read (R-076).

Troll Lair.notes: Border label 'Troll Lair 17K' at a corner of its dotted line (R-132).

Verdantglade III.notes: No way in on foot from Moonveil Woods (fog south of about (168, 94) never moves); entered with the quest's Go travel (R-084, R-089).

Verdantglade IV.notes: Area quests done; % not read since.

Verdantglade V.notes: Auroradrasil sits inside it on the map but is its own zone (R-132): walks to finish V must land on V's own ground. blocked: Sealed Stone Gate at the north edge, about (135, 126) (no rule; dismissed)

Zephyr Vale.notes: Its border label runs sideways along a vertical dotted line, no power shown (R-132).

gaps: Jungle Camp: entry point unknown; the walk in from Drasilgard's south edge gained no % (2026-11-05). Next by the R-135 order, so the next survey's map neighbours are the ones to try.

Connections of Verdantglade IV, V, VI, Drasilgard, Zephyr Vale, Monolith Ruins I, Troll Lair, Wildbloom Coast and Hidden Camp are not mapped yet; the first closer-zoom survey fills map points and map neighbours.
Originisle (explored and blessed) is not in the tree yet.
